title: Entropy-Curvature Scalar Framework: Falsifiable Horndeski-Driven Cosmological Field Dynamics
comments: Submitted with full simulation suite, Docker, and Jupyter companion notebook. Code and data available at [GitHub link]
abstract: We present a unified scalar-entropy framework based on a recursive field Xi(x, t) coupled to curvature, inertia, and gauge structures through generalized Horndeski dynamics. The formalism supports variable gravity, emergent entropy loops, and spontaneous gauge symmetry breaking via Stueckelberg photon mass. Model 5—representing the full curvature feedback case—is simulated across 200 steps and compared to gravitational wave observables, Planck birefringence, and QSO α-drifts. We offer falsifiable predictions testable by NANOGrav, CMB-S4, and optical atomic clocks. A full software suite is released (Docker, Dash, Jupyter, Zenodo archive), enabling public simulation and interaction. This work bridges first-principles Lagrangian physics with observational cosmology and laboratory analogs.
